evidence.reachability: Delete the peer-role-data fact3 and birth only from a truthfully reconstructed publisher purpose/expected-input roster and its own proof joins while keeping the actual fixed body in records. Parent required-roster derivation has no read-set edge for that body; the actual peer child still parses it. This is static Source path analysis, not an executed test.
evidence.repair_boundary: Derive a finite complete consuming-ABI read closure from fixed child Source contracts, including mandatory data bodies and transitive typed metadata/proof inputs. Whole-body/counter accounting stays exact. Do not trust caller expected_inputs, arbitrary serialized child results, mutable private cache callbacks, new result54 fields, counter resets or cap waivers. Source fixtures/helper need exact omission/birth controls for actually consumed child-only bodies.

clauses: publisher purpose finite transitive expected-input closure

evidence.source_reason: _prewrite builds its required set from _declared(req/author/facts) plus the parent g.s.used. _direct passes records to independent child stores but returns only result54 and charged nodes, not a consumed read set. The parent prime deliberately stops at API body edges. Consequently a child-only mandatory body can be present and consumed yet absent from required expected_inputs/births.
evidence.title: Close expected-input and birth roster over actual fixed-child consumption

evidence.concrete_example: A profile draft can declare an additional source_and_harness_authors_excluded_from_review actor. M3 child006+ explicitly collects this actor before its own reviews, but parent _prewrite follows only raw draft pin bytes until after parent common/code reviews and does not add the profile list actor.
evidence.reachability: An otherwise different parent publisher/owner/code proof reviewer can equal an actor occurring only in that operative raw body, while the child uses distinct compliant reviewers. Parent exclusion predicates omit that body actor. No such input was executed.
evidence.repair_boundary: Before any parent proof evaluation, strict-decode and collect actors only from exact body roles designated by the consuming ABI, with whole-byte/hash/schema/node accounting and reviewer-only proof authors kept distinct. Cover M3 four JSON output roles, guard profile/static, peer draft/predecessor nominal actors and relevant phase context APIs. Do not recursively promote unrelated background Source bytes into metadata authority. Fixture mutations must target these raw operative body contexts, not only owner extension fields.
evidence.source_reason: Publisher primes request/author receipts and then calls common/publisher-code/fixed-port proof reviewers. It never explicitly collects operative actor slots in the known profile/static JSON draft, the four typed M3 JSON output roles, or selected-peer original draft/predecessor before those parent reviews. The child kernel builds its own complete union later; that local exclusion set does not update the publisher union.
evidence.title: Collect raw operative role-body actors before parent proof reviews
